qt: to the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Siegbert Frank Droese (ESN) Subject:

What is the opinion of the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning French President Macron’s creation of an ‘anti-ballistic coalition’ against Russia?
Does the Vice-President / High Representative agree with Macron’s statement that Europe must defend itself ‘if necessary with blood’?
at: EN on behalf of the European Commission (17.11.2026) The European Council has welcomed the establishment of the Integrated Anti-Ballistic Missile Coalition, recognising its potential to strengthen European security through enhanced cooperation on missile defence capabilities. Strengthening Europe’s defence readiness and addressing critical capability gaps are essential, particularly in air and missile defence, which has been identified as a priority capability area at EU level. In line with the objectives of the Defence Readiness Roadmap 20301, the EU supports Member States in these efforts by facilitating cooperation, including through providing support to Member State-led capability coalitions, while respecting their national competences and the specific character of their security and defence policies. These efforts aim to deter aggression, prevent conflict and preserve peace by ensuring that Member States have the capabilities needed to protect their citizens and territory. The Coalition’s work will be an important part of these efforts, and the EU will explore ways to support the projects it has identified. Cooperation with Ukraine is also essential. Given the critical shortages of air defence systems and interceptors that Ukraine currently faces, the EU is working with Ukraine to address immediate needs while deepening longer-term defence cooperation. This includes drawing on Ukraine’s battlefield experience and innovative capabilities and integrating them into the European defence ecosystem.
